description: The bar chart, titled "Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models," illustrates the effect of various linguistic features on model performance across different multilingual BERT and XLM models. The horizontal axis categorizes the features into four groups: "case," "gender," "number," and "tense," while the vertical axis represents the "effect" on performance, scaled from -5 to 20. Each feature group contains a set of bars, each corresponding to a specific model, as indicated by the legend: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light red), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). Error bars are included for each bar, indicating the variability of the effect. For the "case" feature, the mBERT-B₂ model shows the highest effect, with a value of approximately 12.5, followed by XLM-B₂ at around 11.5. For the "gender" feature, mBERT-B₂ again shows the highest effect, with a value of about 4.5. In the "number" category, mBERT-B₂ has the highest effect, at approximately 3.0, while for "tense," the highest effect is observed for mBERT-B₂, at about 1.0. The chart also shows that for the "case" feature, mBERT-L₂ has an effect of about 6.0, XLM-L₂ has an effect of about 5.5, mBERT-R₂ has an effect of about 3.0, and XLM-R₂ has an effect of about 2.5. For the "gender" feature, mBERT-L₂ has an effect of about 1.5, XLM-L₂ has an effect of about 0.5, mBERT-R₂ has an effect of about 2.0, and XLM-R₂ has an effect of about 1.0. For the "number" feature, mBERT-L₂ has an effect of about 1.5, XLM-L₂ has an effect of about 1.0, mBERT-R₂ has an effect of about 1.5, and XLM-R₂ has an effect of about 0.5. For the "tense" feature, mBERT-L₂ has an effect of about 0.5, XLM-L₂ has an effect of about 0.5, mBERT-R₂ has an effect of about 0.5, and XLM-R₂ has an effect of about 0.5. The bars are sorted in descending order of effect for each feature group, with the highest effect bars appearing first. The chart visually emphasizes the performance differences between the models across the different linguistic features, with mBERT-B₂ generally showing the highest effect in most categories.
